title: graph-edit-2d widget params
description: A self-contained 'build the graph' engine: the reader edits a small graph in place — click empty space to add a vertex, drag between two vertices to toggle an edge, click a vertex to delete it — and the author's draw(g) re-renders the graph and any live graph invariant (connected components, a greedy colouring, degree sequence, a spanning forest, the Laplacian spectrum, …) after every edit. The renderer owns the edit gesture (pointer hit-testing, the rubber-band edge drag, add/delete/toggle, a Reset button) and the data model; the author writes only draw(g) in params.bodyScript and reads g.nodes / g.edges / g.adj / g.deg(id) / g.n / g.m / g.R. The gesture is 'graph-edit' — a direct-manipulation dimension the corpus otherwise lacks. jsdom-safe: createSVGPoint/getScreenCTM run only inside pointer handlers, never at init.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget"> wrapper. The Reset button derives its id from it (widgetId+'-reset').

svgId.description: DOM id for the <svg> drawing surface.

outputId.description: DOM id for the .readout the author writes into.

hint.description: Optional hint in .hd > .hint. Should explain the three gestures (add vertex / toggle edge / delete vertex).

svgTitle.description: Accessible <title> inside the SVG. Defaults to title.

nodeRadius.description: Vertex radius in px, used for both hit-testing and as the helper g.R the author draws with. Default 16.

pad.description: Inner padding (px) added vertices are clamped to. Default 24.

initialNodes.description: Initial vertices as [x, y] pixel pairs in viewBox coordinates. Reset restores these.

initialEdges.description: Initial edges as [i, j] pairs of indices into initialNodes. Reset restores these.

bodyScript.description: Author JS defining `function draw(g){ ... }`. It clears+redraws the SVG group `G`, writes `out`, and reads the live model: g.nodes ([{id,x,y}] in pixel coords), g.edges ([{u,v}] with vertex ids), g.adj ({id:[neighbourId,…]}), g.deg(id), g.n, g.m, and g.R (vertex radius). It may use the page-global $/SVG. Called once at init and after every edit and Reset. Must not start a timer.
